decisions.reason: As an adjacent, modular machine-tool fluid product in an expanding and R&D-active firm, it is more likely to be retained than withdrawn despite the lack of later website evidence.
This hydrocyclone coolant filter builds directly on the firm's core filtration and fluid-handling offer, so a growing one-stop supplier would usually keep it in the range.
A gravity band coolant filter fits the established coolant filtration portfolio well, and broad-range German machinery suppliers typically continue such core variants unless results are clearly weak.
